relationships.subject: Qufeng Zhitong capsule
relationships.evidence_quote: QFZTC dose-dependently reduced the expression of Iba-1, TLR4, MyD88, and p-P65 in the spinal cord

relationships.subject: Qufeng Zhitong capsule
relationships.evidence_quote: QFZTC inhibited the expression of the c-Fos pain marker and reduced the expression of the TNF-α, IL-6, and IL-1β inflammatory factors.

relationships.subject: Qufeng Zhitong capsule
relationships.evidence_quote: Treatment with QFZTC significantly relieved mechanical allodynia and thermal hyperalgesia in CCI mice models.

key_findings: QFZTC relieved neuropathic pain in CCI mice, reducing spinal TLR4/MyD88/p-P65 and TNF-α, IL-6, IL-1β.
